verdict.rationale: The only documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint is the hosted Wally Cloud API, where OpenAI clients point `base_url` at it (docs-4). Separately, the same CLI runs small models locally and offline (docs-6), and one command points a tool at a model and starts it (docs-7). Together these only imply, and do not document, a local OpenAI-compatible server. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a local OpenAI-compatible server mode, any command or port details for serving locally, support for serving any loaded model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
